steps.title: Day 1 — Your kit and your path
steps.description:
Welcome to Week 0! Today is about getting set up: read the Welcome Guide, choose the path that suits you, and set a goal for the next 12 weeks.

Plan & Swap follows a meal plan and makes swaps — the default if you're new to this. Track Serves counts hand-portion serves. Protein + Calories tracks protein grams and calories. You can change paths any week, so don't overthink it.

steps.title: Week 1 — Protein at Every Meal
steps.description:
**Why:** Protein spread across meals keeps you full and recovering all day.

**Key teaching:**
- 1.6 to 2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight a day.
- Split it into 3 to 4 meals of 25 to 40 g.
- 1 serve ≈ 30 g ≈ 1 palm.
- Fix breakfast first.

steps.title: Week 11 — Mindset and Easing Off Tracking
steps.description:
**Why:** You've learnt what tracking was teaching you. Now you can trust it.

**Key teaching:**
- Eat around 3 to 4 on the hunger scale and stop around 6 to 7.
- Use hand portions and the plate instead of measuring.
- Feel off track? Track for 1 to 2 days, then stop again.
